note: State beach on the Santa Barbara Channel in the town of Carpinteria, south of Santa Barbara, with four loops along a mile of beach. Anacapa and Santa Cruz have no hookups; Santa Rosa has full hookups throughout; San Miguel has water and electric at 420-446. Check each site's posted length when booking. --Claude
summary: ReserveCalifornia and parks.ca.gov read. 178 family sites at $45 standard / $60 premium / $70 hookups / $80 premium full hookup (the stored fees match). 30 A. About 80 sites take 23 ft. Max stay 7 nights Mar-Nov. Reservations close Feb 15-Mar 13, 2027 for maintenance. Phone change suggested. Waterfront: bayfront isn't supported at the RV pads; coastal walk recommended.
flags:
WATERFRONT (recommend bayfront -> coastal walk, or bayview; not --AWH): no RV pad meets the ~50 m open-apron bound.
- Santa Rosa beach row (358-380; e.g. 34.38975,-119.51840): pads at ~4.2-4.4 m. 3DEP falls gently across open sand to 2.1 m at 66 m, and the water starts at ~72 m; imagery puts the surf ~80 m out. Open and unscreened, so at least bayview, but beyond the ~50 m bound.
- San Miguel beach row (447-456; e.g. 34.38800,-119.51550): ~30-37 m from the surf, but the pads sit ~5.2 m up. 3DEP drops to 0.7 m within 20 m over a rocky revetment bank. That's a view under the kayak test.
- Santa Cruz south row (201-220): screened by a continuous shrub and dune-vegetation band, with 100+ m of beach beyond.
- Coastal walk is earned: the beach is the park's own, a few steps from every loop, with only park roads in between. The railroad and US 101 are inland of the camp, not between it and the shore.
The stored evidence ('~35-40 m of open unused sand ... no road, dune ridge or developed strip') was read at 34.3900,-119.5165 and missed the San Miguel bank height. Proposed evidence: 'parks.ca.gov map + 3DEP/Esri 2026-11-27: Santa Rosa beach row pads ~4.3 m, open sand to the water at ~70 m (beyond 50 m); San Miguel beach row ~35 m from surf but ~5 m up a rocky bank; Santa Cruz south row behind a dune-scrub band; the park's own beach within a short walk of every loop, no highway, town or rail line between -> coastal walk.' The beach-row sites are 18-21 ft anyway, so a 23-ft rig books only the 30-35 ft inland and long-row sites.
PHONE: 805-968-1033 -> 805-566-2494. The park page ('Contact Information (805) 566-2494') and the campground map both give it; 805-968-1033 appears on neither.

WEBSITE: stored 'https://www.parks.ca.gov/carpinteria' + 'https://www.reservecalifornia.com'. Suggest https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=599 and the ReserveCalifornia deep link https://www.reservecalifornia.com/Web/#!park/6 (PlaceId 6).

SITE LENGTHS: the map gives 21 ft for most Santa Rosa and San Miguel hookup sites. The 30-ft long rows (Santa Rosa 340-357 full hookups; San Miguel 434-446 water/electric, except 439-440 at 25 ft) and the 35-ft Anacapa/Santa Cruz no-hookup sites fit a 23-ft rig. sites.count 216 -> 178 (ReserveCalifornia's family campsites; the stored 216 came from note prose).
